title: OpenAI Pauses Training of New AI Models, Citing Cybersecurity Worries - CNET
summary: OpenAI says in its blog post: “Our current estimates put monitoring overhead at roughly 20% of the inference compute being monitored,” meaning that monitoring AI models during the training process accounts for a significant portion of OpenAI’s compute.
